Container.Name: vpn-sentinel-client
Container.Overview: VPNSentinel client: runs inside your VPN container's network (for example gluetun) and reports every 60 seconds whether traffic really goes through the VPN and whether DNS leaks, to a VPNSentinel server. Setup: (1) In Extra Parameters, change gluetun in --network=container:gluetun to the exact name of your VPN container. (2) Set the server URL to http://HOST:PORT, where HOST is the Unraid host and PORT is the server's mapped API port. (3) In the VPN container, set FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS to include the LAN subnet of that host, otherwise the keepalive is blocked and the client never turns green; the client then logs "Failed to send keepalive" and does not appear on the dashboard. (4) Use the same API key and API path as the server. Notes: recreating the VPN container breaks this container until it is recreated too, and Unraid may display the port mappings wrongly when --network= is set in Extra Parameters.
Container.Requires: A running VPN container (for example gluetun) and a VPNSentinel server.

Config.Name: Server URL
Config.Description: Required. URL of the VPNSentinel server API: http://HOST:PORT with the Unraid host and the server's mapped API port. The VPN container's FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS must include the LAN subnet of HOST.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Must equal the server's API key.

Config.Name: Client ID
Config.Description: Optional name shown on the dashboard, kebab-case, for example office-vpn-primary. Generated when empty.

Config.Name: API path
Config.Description: API path prefix. Must match the server.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Timezone for log timestamps, for example Europe/Rome.
